SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(yt) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips 
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 25
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC;

SELECT report_date_doy, yt_local, yt_coronado, yt_north, yt_all 
FROM fishdope 
WHERE report_date_season = 6 
ORDER BY report_date_doy DESC 
LIMIT 5;

import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']
fishdope = tables['fishdope']

s6_trips = trips[trips['fish_date_season'] == 6]
s6_recent = s6_trips[s6_trips['fish_date_doy'] >= 25].copy()

perf_by_class = s6_recent.groupby(['fish_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'boat': 'count'
}).reset_index()

perf_by_class['yt_per_angler'] = perf_by_class['yt'] / perf_by_class['anglers']
perf_by_class = perf_by_class.rename(columns={'boat': 'trips'})

long_boats = perf_by_class[perf_by_class['cls'].isin(['day_1_5', 'overnight', 'multi_day'])]
print("Long boat performance (day_1_5, overnight, multi_day) - last 7 days:")
print(long_boats.sort_values(['fish_date_doy', 'yt_per_angler'], ascending=[False, False]))

print("\n\nOverall by class (S6 all data):")

    'yt': 'sum',

}).reset_index()

overall = overall.rename(columns={'boat': 'trips'})
